$comment: US-2447 AC3: HOST-level scheduled work, as data, so its absence is checkable from a checkout.
SCOPE, stated so this is not mistaken for something bigger. This file covers only
schedules that run ON THE HOST, outside the edge service — things a `crontab -l` would
show and nothing in the repo otherwise knows about. The ~74 EDGE cron jobs (the
/api/jobs/* endpoints an operator wires up as Coolify tasks) are a different problem
with a different registry: CRON_REGISTRY in services/edge-functions/src/lib/ops-jobs.ts,
and US-2313 owns making THOSE verifiable. Adding them here would produce two
half-registries that disagree, which is the shape this repo keeps learning to avoid.
'verifiable' says how a checkout can tell whether the entry is actually installed.
'heartbeat' means the job reports in and something serves the last-seen time;
'none' means it cannot be checked without SSH, which is a gap and should say so.

schedules.purpose: Restart the edge container when Docker marks it unhealthy. `restart: unless-stopped` fires on process EXIT and an edge hang never exits, so this is the only thing that ends a hang.
